reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly linking local chemical disorder to force-constant fluctuations and enhanced phonon scattering, though the quantitative predictions (20% accuracy, 30% reduction) are speculative without a specific model framework.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on a direct comparison of thermal conductivity between model-selected and control alloys, though the practical feasibility of synthesizing and measuring many alloys is challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is highly useful as it addresses a key gap in predicting low thermal conductivity in HEAs and proposes a concrete, testable mechanism that could guide future material screening.
